# Native CAD import geometry fixture

The SolidWorks part and its STEP geometry twin come from NIST's Model-Based
Engineering PMI validation files, distributed as U.S. Government works in the
public domain under 17 U.S.C. §105. They were sourced from the cadmpeg v0.6.12
corpus; NIST is the author. The STEP file is used only as a geometry comparison
input, not as a PMI reference.

- Native part: `nist_ftc_06_asme1_rd_sw1802.SLDPRT` (NIST FTC-06, SolidWorks
  MBD 2018), SHA-256 `6612f7bc9b2b15373789afe8032a153d84af7d619dbeb984c3a75cb360456bd3`.
- Geometry twin: `nist_ftc_06_asme1_ap242-e2.stp`, SHA-256
  `b87afb7f25adc0d44d12e182209d50f0b085b533c0742fb8ffd58f4c87403447`.

NIST source page: <https://www.nist.gov/document/nist-ftc-ctc-pmi-cad-models>

Upstream corpus notes, acquisition provenance and the public-domain disclaimer:
<https://github.com/cadmpeg/cadmpeg/blob/v0.6.12/corpus/nist-pmi/README.md>
